answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks when each identity requires mining a unique token through proof-of-work puzzles. Provers must illuminate a digital quill that etches verification codes across fragmented shale-like data structures, consuming computational energy that scales inversely with authentication frequency. The ivory tower of centralized control crumbles under market dynamics where creation costs exceed potential gains, forcing attackers to expend real resources rather than fabricate endless counterfeit personas.
